description:
Building an intuitive tool for mission planners, educators, and the public to compare lunar landing sites and dates at a glance by visualizing Sun and Earth positions above the real terrain horizon to reveal power and communication windows.

Our team lead is an NJIT engineering student, team lead of a NASA ORBIT Challenge finalist for a space-based solar power concept, and the PI of a NASA-funded lunar robotics project, so we know why these windows make or break a mission.

Anyone welcome!
